goals.note: y49 sits inside the mine_grid zone (zones.json, y45-62) so skills.branchMine's own DIG LAW zone check passes as long as the bot's x/z is also inside that box. minDurability 30 is a FLOOR (overseer.mjs goalEligible: only eligible while the pickaxe still has >=30% life left) so a long corridor never breaks the pick mid-dig. 'food' from the design brief is read as bread on hand (items schema has no live-hunger-stat requires clause). Priority hand-set from the iron_ingot severity formula at seed time (current 0 / min 64 / target 280 -> severity 1.0) -- not live-recomputed like the deficit engine's dynamic wood-chop entry. requires.nearZone:'mine_grid' added (repair, 2026-09-01): branchMine's own pre-dig check only verifies the bot's x/z with the GOAL's y substituted in (see skills.js branchMine, opts.y never relocates the bot) -- without a nearZone gate here, that band-substitution trick let the check pass for a miner idling at a SURFACE workstation whose x/z happens to sit inside mine_grid's footprint (Thak 24,90,64 and Durk 16,89,52 both do), firing a full trunk+branch dig AT THE SURFACE instead of the deep-iron layer. The standard +-24 pad (GOAL_ZONE_PAD, same convention cobble-mine already uses below) puts mine_grid's vertical envelope at y21-86 -- comfortably excluding every miner's y89/90 idle spot while still admitting a bot genuinely staged near the y45-62 layer.

CURATOR-TOGGLED: furnace availability is a chat-convention lease between drivers (see DRIVER_GUIDE.md), never parsed or enforced by the engine -- this goal only ever checks bot-readiness (raw_iron+coal on hand). Comment out or delete by hand if the camp furnace is leased elsewhere. count:1 deliberately, not a batch -- single-craft law (see FEEDBACK.md 'batch craft silently drops items' + skills.js craftItem's single-craft-loop fix); repeat:true fires it again next tick per remaining raw_iron instead of ever requesting a bigger batch.

CURATOR-TOGGLED like iron-smelt above -- crafting-table availability is chat convention, not engine-enforced. Feeds the deep-iron-branchmine torch>=8 requirement directly. amount:1, not a batch -- single-craft law (see FEEDBACK.md torch-batch item-loss bug); repeat:true covers the rest one craft at a time.

Background readiness filler -- deliberately the LOWEST priority of every seed goal so it only fires once nothing more valuable is eligible. skills.ensureTool() no-ops (just re-equips) if a pickaxe of ANY durability is already held, so this only actually re-kits once the equipped pick fully breaks (0 durability -> removed from inventory in vanilla) and none is left in the depot/craft chain fallback. Uses the new POST /ensureTool endpoint (runner.js, 2026-09-01).
